part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `packages/runtime-core/src/helpers/renderList.ts`: `isReactive()` returns true for shallowReactive arrays, so v-for items were wrapped with `toReactive()` (deep reactive proxies), converting refs inside items.

The fix adds an `isShallow(source)` check (packages/runtime-core/src/helpers/renderList.ts:86) so shallowReactive arrays keep their items raw — matching upstream Vue's behavior. All 898 runtime-core tests and the typecheck pass, including the `renderList` shallowReactive test expecting items to be non-reactive.
